about: Default portraits (dungeon/art.py stock_portrait): stock pictures of common kinds of people, shown on the stage for someone met who has no portrait of their own. Made once with scripts/art/portraits.py; the images are assets/portraits/<id>.webp (600x800). A portrait is picked by the person's folk, then the words of their job (`roles`), their pronouns and their age (`age`: young under 30, middle under 55, old), else a `default` one; people who match the same entries are spread across them by key.
portrait_style: Photorealistic 35mm portrait photograph, natural light, autumn 2009 in a small upstate New York college town, period-accurate clothes, hair and makeup (no smartphones), head and shoulders, softly blurred background
portrait_avoid: text, lettering, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, a second person, smartphone, airpods
